gen-comfortaa-gf-antic-slab: Dignified and editorial, the text serif in Antic Slab has round bowls and wide, barely curled s curves. Comfortaa is best at friendly, ring-shaped geometry up top, while Antic Slab is best at carrying the grown-up voice below.
gen-comfortaa-gf-arvo: Arvo reads like a traditional, dignified classic serif, its curves stopping short of closing, while Comfortaa draws with a ballpoint's pressure-free line. One is playful display geometry; the other is steady text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-belgrano: Round, friendly, and a bit retro. Comfortaa's t has a crossbar and stem of one width, and Belgrano's open-mouthed text serif curves suggest giving the body a little more size than you'd expect.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biorhyme: BioRhyme has brush-lifted curve ends and widely spaced capitals, giving a bookish, refined classic serif feel. Comfortaa's straight-edged, constant strokes make the sharpest foil, and BioRhyme's tapered ends carry the warmth.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biorhyme-expanded: BioRhyme Expanded is a refined, bookish classic serif whose open gaps pull each word apart into single letters. And Comfortaa's single-weight outline feel keeps the heading light, so a longer passage would move slowly and deliberately.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biz-udmincho: BIZ UDMincho is a bookish classic serif with a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap in its curves, set under Comfortaa's modulation-free heading. The strongest quality here is how a ring-round display face sits beside such traditional text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-copse: Comfortaa draws every stroke like a tube of constant width, wrapped around a wide-open c. And Copse, a literary serif with daylight through each curved opening, would make a longer passage feel light and unhurried.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cutive: Refined and literary, Cutive spaces its running text widely and leaves a generous opening in c. Comfortaa is best at plain, unmodulated outline shapes up top, while Cutive is best at a slow, typewriter-like cadence below.
gen-comfortaa-gf-david-libre: Round, tubular, and friendly, Comfortaa runs a neon-tube consistency through every stroke. David Libre then adds dignified, refined serif terminals that hang open, so the two feel like a joke told in a quiet room.
gen-comfortaa-gf-enriqueta: Soft rings, then chalky curves. Comfortaa is best at giving every stroke the same visual weight, and Enriqueta is best at literary, dignified text serif curves that stop well before closing.
